name: Four Seasons Resort Langkawi
positioning: Beachfront resort of pavilions and villas at Tanjung Rhu on Langkawi, set within the Langkawi UNESCO Global Geopark
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront pavilion or villa stay with private pools
Families wanting a supervised kids' program and multi-bedroom villas

facts.text: The resort has 92 rooms in total.
Of the resort's rooms, 68 are pavilions.
Of the resort's rooms, 24 are villas.
The resort is set on the north-eastern cape of Tanjung Rhu on the Andaman Sea.
The resort is nestled within the Langkawi UNESCO Global Geopark.
The resort has a mile-long private beach.
The design is inspired by a blend of Moorish architecture and a traditional Malay kampung, or village, setting.
Kelapa Grill serves fresh local seafood and flame-grilled steaks at night.
The Geo Spa has six treatment rooms.

highlights.text: Beach Villa with Pool is a private oceanfront villa.
The resort has an infinity-edge lap pool overlooking the Andaman Sea, with private cabanas.
The resort is a sanctuary for several tropical bird species, including hornbills.
The Mangroves and Eagles Safari is a three-hour mangrove river safari guided by a Four Seasons naturalist.
Cooking classes let guests learn about Malaysian cuisine with a local chef.
Kids for All Seasons is a supervised program in a dedicated facility.

considerations.text: The resort is approximately 25 minutes by car from Langkawi International Airport.
The resort is approximately a 30-minute drive from Kuah Town, Langkawi's main commercial centre.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires additional travel planning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
